notes: The step from the mesa pattern to 'neither selection nor drift' rests on a premise no harvested Day text states (one 'uniform-rate' occurrence, in Q164 itself). The printed 3.76 and 3.39 are 0.008 and 0.006 above the ratio of their printed parts (3.752, 3.384), inside the rounding of those parts; the ratios were taken from unrounded values. The object statement's 'which Day's own relictation contradicts' is stronger than claim ROOT-FM, which finds N2b not triggered because FM10 names diffusive drift; both are recorded and no verdict moves (FM10 internal pending, owner 2026-10-10).
